about: An empty-invocation default does not hide the root's own candidates from completion: the word under the cursor is still to be typed.

vectors.doc: At the root, completion offers the subcommands, not only the default command's arguments.
vectors.spec:
name "x"
bin "x"
flag "--rootf"
default_subcommand "def"
default_subcommand_on_empty #true
cmd "def" {
 flag "--x <x>"
 arg "[a]"
}
cmd "other"

vectors.doc: At the root, completion offers the root's flags rather than the default command's.
vectors.spec:
name "x"
bin "x"
flag "--rootf"
default_subcommand "def"
default_subcommand_on_empty #true
cmd "def" {
 flag "--x <x>"
 arg "[a]"
}
cmd "other"
